EQL cup 3 is the third short version of a tournament held by EQL. The tournament starts on the 18th of March and will end the 21st of April.

These are the [https://strawpoll.com/40Zmq8VblZa/results community predictions] of the finalists of division 1.

[https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLrrIZPHgAIRoWmFScNRDctCVk5-eXIZuu This is a list of VODs] with live commentary by Badsebi.
